title: Cult Classics of the 80s
intro: The 80s had a darker pulse running under the neon. These six films found it and refused to look away.

films.title: Blue Velvet
films.line: A small town hides something rotting and beautiful just beneath the surface.

films.title: Repo Man
films.line: Punks, aliens and existential dread collide in the most electrifying midnight fever dream.

films.title: Manhunter
films.line: A hunter who thinks like a monster walks a razor edge he may never come back from.

films.title: Society
films.line: The more he tries to belong, the more wrong everything feels, right up until it breaks open.

films.title: They Live
films.line: Put on the glasses and you will never unsee what the world has been hiding in plain sight.

films.title: Videodrome
films.line: Reality bends and bleeds once a late night signal starts rewiring something deep in the mind.
